default.title: WarmDesk
default.intro: Context-sensitive help for the page you are on. Open this panel anytime from the help button in the header.
tasks: Use the sidebar to switch projects, customers, and chats.
Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) to search cards, tickets, and people.
Open Settings from the user menu to change language, theme, and notifications.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your home view: pinned projects, recent activity, and quick access to starred customers.
tasks: Star projects and customers in the sidebar to pin them here.
Create a new project with the button on this page.
Set Dashboard shows in Settings to open Tickets instead of Boards on login.

board.title: Kanban board
board.intro: Manage work as cards moving through columns. Drag cards to update status.
tasks: Drag a card to another column to change its status.
Click a card to edit details, comments, checklists, and attachments.
Open the chat panel to discuss work with the project team.
Set a WIP limit on a column header to cap work in progress.
shortcuts: Esc — close the open card detail panel

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.intro: Scrum backlog: prioritise cards that are not yet in an active sprint.
tasks: Drag cards to reorder priority.
Move cards into the active sprint from the sprint panel.
Create new cards directly in the backlog.

sprintBoard.title: Sprint board
sprintBoard.intro: The active sprint shown as a Kanban board with a fixed scope.
tasks: Move cards across columns as work progresses.
Complete the sprint from the sprint menu when all work is done or carried over.
Open Charts to view burndown for this sprint.

epics.title: Epics
epics.intro: Group related cards under epics for Scrum planning and burndown tracking.
tasks: Create an epic and assign a colour.
Link cards to an epic from the card detail panel.
Open an epic to see its cards and burndown chart.

gantt.title: Gantt chart
gantt.intro: Timeline view of cards with start and due dates.
tasks: Set start and due dates on cards to see them on the timeline.
Drag bars to adjust dates when you have edit access.
Scroll horizontally to move through time.

charts.title: Charts
charts.intro: Scrum analytics: burndown, velocity, and epic progress for this project.
tasks: Select a sprint to view its burndown chart.
Switch tabs to compare velocity across sprints.
Select an epic to see remaining work over time.

topics.title: Topics
topics.intro: Structured discussions separate from the board chat — useful for decisions and long threads.
tasks: Create a topic with a title and optional description.
Reply in threads to keep conversation organised.
Close a topic when the discussion is resolved.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.intro: Configure members, integrations, and project-specific options.
tasks: Invite members and set their project role (viewer, member, owner).
Configure GitHub or GitLab webhooks for automation.
Manage project API keys for CI/CD ticket creation.

settings.title: User settings
settings.intro: Your personal profile, security, appearance, and notification preferences.
tasks: Update display name, email, avatar, and date/time format.
Enable MFA or register a passkey for stronger sign-in.
Choose whether the dashboard opens on Boards or Tickets.
Set working hours used as defaults in time tracking.

chats.title: Chats
chats.intro: Direct messages and group conversations with voice and video calls.
tasks: Start a chat from the People list in the sidebar.
Use @mentions in project chat or DMs to notify someone.
Start a voice or video call from the conversation header.
React to messages with emoji hover actions.

news.title: News
news.intro: Announcements from your organisation shown on the dashboard and this page.
tasks: Read pinned announcements from administrators.
Dismiss items from the dashboard; they remain listed here.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Customer records used for contracts, time tracking, and helpdesk tickets.
tasks: Open a customer to view contracts and members.
Star customers to pin them in the sidebar.
Jump to tickets for a customer when helpdesk is enabled.

customerDetail.title: Customer detail
customerDetail.intro: Contracts, assigned members, and links to tickets for one customer.
tasks: Review contract rates and undeclarable time rules.
See which agents have access to this customer's tickets.
Open the ticket list for this customer from the header actions.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.intro: Helpdesk ticket list for one customer — filter, sort, and create new tickets.
tasks: Use filters for status, priority, assignee, and tags.
Switch between table and card views.
Create a ticket manually or wait for incoming email (when IMAP is configured).

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: Tickets that arrived by email and are not yet linked to a customer.
tasks: Review new email tickets and assign them to a customer.
Mark spam to hide unwanted mail from the default list.
Open a ticket to reply or merge it into an existing case.

ticketDetail.title: Ticket detail
ticketDetail.intro: View and update a ticket, reply to the requester, and apply macros or checklists.
tasks: Change status, priority, type, assignee, and tags from the header.
Add a public reply (emailed to the requester) or a private internal note.
Apply a macro to run preset actions in one click.
Set a reminder date on pending tickets or a close date on pending close.

timeTracking.title: Time tracking
timeTracking.intro: Log hours, run personal reports, and export board time reports.
tasks: Switch tabs for Log Time, Report, or Board report.
Navigate weeks with the arrows or click the week label.
Managers can view other users' sheets when permitted.

timeTrackingSheet.title: Log time
timeTrackingSheet.intro: Weekly grid: enter hours per customer, project, and activity.
tasks: Type hours in a cell — use your preferred decimal or hh:mm format from settings.
Click the clock icon to set start/end times on an entry.
Copy the previous week or use standby shift for contract overnight rates.
Drag row handles to reorder lines.
shortcuts: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V — copy and paste cells

timeTrackingReport.title: Time report
timeTrackingReport.intro: Personal time report with grouping, filters, and PDF/XLSX export.
tasks: Set the date range and group by customer, project, or activity.
Expand groups to see individual entries.
Export PDF or Excel for billing or archiving.

timeTrackingBoardReport.title: Board time report
timeTrackingBoardReport.intro: Project-board time aggregated for reporting — requires report viewer permission.
tasks: Filter by project, customer, assignee, and date range.
Review declarable vs undeclarable totals when configured.
Download PDF or XLSX from the export buttons.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Manage users, projects, system settings, helpdesk configuration, and backups.
tasks: Use the tabs to switch between Users, Settings, SLA, Macros, and more.
Changes to SMTP, IMAP, and security settings apply without a server restart.
Open this help panel on each tab for specific guidance.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.intro: Create and manage user accounts, roles, and feature flags.
tasks: Set global role: admin, member, viewer, or customer (tickets only).
Enable helpdesk, time tracking, or report access per user.
Assign customers to customer-role users for ticket visibility.

adminGroups.title: Groups
adminGroups.intro: Organise users and grant customer access to whole teams at once.
tasks: Create a group and add members.
Assign customer access with a role — highest role wins when combined with direct access.

adminCustomers.title: Customers (admin)
adminCustomers.intro: Create customers, contracts, and access rules.
tasks: Add contracts with rates used in time reports.
Assign agents to customers for ticket access and assignee dropdowns.
Configure undeclarable minutes on time-tracking-only projects.

adminProjects.title: Projects (admin)
adminProjects.intro: Overview of all projects, board type, and archival.
tasks: Create Kanban or Scrum projects — board type is fixed after creation.
Archive projects to hide them without deleting history.
Restore archived projects when needed.

adminSettings.title: System settings
adminSettings.intro: SMTP, IMAP, branding, security, and defaults for new users and projects.
tasks: Configure outgoing mail before password reset and notifications work.
Set up IMAP polling to create tickets from incoming email.
Restrict API access with allowed IP ranges — test carefully before saving.
Upload a company logo shown on reports and optionally on the login page.

adminNews.title: News (admin)
adminNews.intro: Publish announcements shown on the dashboard and News page.
tasks: Write markdown content with a title and optional expiry date.
Pin important items so they stay visible.
Leave date empty to show immediately with no end date.

adminTimeTracking.title: Time tracking (admin)
adminTimeTracking.intro: Manage time-tracking-only projects and customers used on timesheets.
tasks: Create TT projects with optional undeclarable minutes per entry.
Link TT customers to billing entities on reports.
Set hourly rates on customer contracts for cost columns in exports.

adminSla.title: SLA policies
adminSla.intro: Define response and resolution targets by ticket priority.
tasks: Create a policy matching a priority or use a catch-all.
Set targets in hours; breach flags update when tickets are viewed.
Deactivate a policy instead of deleting if you may need it again.

adminMacros.title: Macros
adminMacros.intro: Reusable action sequences agents apply to tickets in one click.
tasks: Combine set status, set priority, add tag, and add message actions.
Use placeholders like {agent}, {subject}, and {ticket_id} in messages.
Drag placeholders from the list into message action text.

adminTicketChecklists.title: Ticket checklists
adminTicketChecklists.intro: Templates applied to tickets — items must be completed before closing.
tasks: Define checklist items in a template.
Agents apply a template from the ticket detail view.
Closing is blocked until every item is checked off.

adminBackup.title: Backup
tasks: Create a backup before major upgrades or migrations.
Download the file and store it off the server.
Restore replaces the live database — schedule downtime first.

cardDetail.title: Card detail
cardDetail.intro: Edit all fields on a card: description, dates, assignees, checklists, attachments, and links.
tasks: Use the ⋮ menu to show or hide sections (checklist, sub-cards, git links, etc.).
Add sub-cards for smaller tasks — they only appear here, not on the board.
Link related cards or tickets with the linked cards section.
Copy or transfer the card to another project from the footer actions.
Press Esc to close this panel.

projectSettingsGeneral.title: Project — General
projectSettingsGeneral.intro: Name, appearance, customer link, and contract for this project.
tasks: Assign a customer and contract for time tracking and reporting.
Upload a project avatar shown in the sidebar and board toolbar.
Board type (Kanban or Scrum) was set at creation and cannot be changed.

projectSettingsMembers.title: Project — Members
projectSettingsMembers.intro: Who can access this project and with what role.
tasks: Invite users by username with viewer, member, or owner role.
Add a whole group to grant access to every member at once.
Owners can change settings; viewers see the board read-only.

projectSettingsLabels.title: Project — Labels
projectSettingsLabels.intro: Colour tags applied to cards for filtering and visual grouping.
tasks: Create labels with a name and colour.
Delete unused labels — they are removed from all cards.

projectSettingsApiKeys.title: Project — API keys
projectSettingsApiKeys.intro: Keys for the Ticket API and automation (CI/CD creating cards).
tasks: Create a key with a descriptive name.
Copy the key when shown — it cannot be retrieved later.
Revoke keys that are no longer needed.

projectSettingsWebhooks.title: Project — Webhooks
projectSettingsWebhooks.intro: GitHub and GitLab webhooks that create or update cards from commits and MRs.
tasks: Copy the webhook URL and token into your repository settings.
Regenerate the token if it is compromised.
Each platform has its own URL path — use the matching tab.

projectSettingsDeletedCards.title: Project — Deleted cards
projectSettingsDeletedCards.intro: Soft-deleted cards that can be restored or permanently removed.
tasks: Open a deleted card to review its contents before restoring.
Restore returns the card to its original column.
Permanent delete cannot be undone.

settingsProfile.title: Profile & preferences
settingsProfile.intro: Your name, locale, theme, notifications, and dashboard defaults.
tasks: Set language, timezone, and date/time format for the whole UI.
Enable email notifications for mentions, DMs, and card assignments.
Choose Boards or Tickets as the default view after login.
Toggle personal time tracking if your organisation uses timesheets.

settingsWorkingHours.title: Working hours
settingsWorkingHours.intro: Default start time per weekday — used as hints on the time-tracking grid.
tasks: Leave a day blank if you do not work that day.
Times use your chosen time notation (decimal or hh:mm).
Save profile after editing — working hours are part of your profile.

settingsPassword.title: Change password
settingsPassword.intro: Update your login password. Policy rules are set by your administrator.
tasks: Enter your current password, then a new one meeting the listed requirements.
You may be forced to change an expired password before continuing.

settingsMfa.title: Two-factor authentication
settingsMfa.intro: Add a TOTP app (Google Authenticator, etc.) for extra sign-in security.
tasks: Scan the QR code or enter the secret manually in your authenticator app.
Enter a 6-digit code to confirm setup.
Store recovery access safely — you need the app code on every login when enabled.

settingsPasskey.title: Passkeys
settingsPasskey.intro: Sign in with device biometrics or a security key instead of a password.
tasks: Register a passkey from the device you use to sign in.
You can register multiple passkeys and remove old ones.
Passkeys work alongside password and MFA depending on server policy.

settingsApiKeys.title: Personal API keys
settingsApiKeys.intro: Your own API keys for scripts and integrations (not project ticket keys).
tasks: Create a named key and copy it immediately.
Revoke keys you no longer use.

chartsVelocity.title: Velocity chart
chartsVelocity.intro: Story points completed per sprint — helps forecast future sprints.
tasks: Only completed sprints appear.
Ensure cards have story points set for meaningful bars.

chartsThroughput.title: Throughput
chartsThroughput.intro: Number of cards closed per sprint or per week (Kanban).
tasks: For Kanban, pick 4–26 weeks in the dropdown.
For Scrum, throughput is grouped by completed sprint.

chartsBurndown.title: Burndown
chartsBurndown.intro: Remaining story points in the selected sprint over time.
tasks: Select the active or a past sprint from the dropdown.
Ideal line assumes even burn; actual line follows card completions.

chartsBurnup.title: Burn-up
chartsBurnup.intro: Cumulative work completed in a sprint versus total scope.
tasks: Scope changes (cards added mid-sprint) show as steps in the total line.
Select the sprint to analyse.

chartsCfd.title: Cumulative flow
chartsCfd.intro: Stacked areas showing card count per column over time.
tasks: Growing bands in one column may indicate a bottleneck.
Available for both Kanban and Scrum projects.

chartsSprintReport.title: Sprint report
chartsSprintReport.intro: Summary of a completed sprint: committed vs completed work.
tasks: Select a sprint to see carried-over and completed cards.
Use after sprint review meetings.

chartsEpicBurndown.title: Epic burndown
chartsEpicBurndown.intro: Remaining story points for one epic over time.
tasks: Select an epic from the dropdown.
Link cards to the epic from card detail for accurate totals.

chartsReleaseBurndown.title: Release burndown
chartsReleaseBurndown.intro: Progress toward a release target across epics and sprints.
tasks: Configure release scope via epics and sprint planning.
Use for fixed-date release tracking.

chartsCycleTime.title: Cycle time
chartsCycleTime.intro: How long cards spend in progress (start to done).
tasks: Set start dates on cards for accurate measurement.
Scatter plot shows per-card cycle time.

chartsLeadTime.title: Lead time
chartsLeadTime.intro: Time from card creation to completion.
tasks: Useful for Kanban flow metrics and SLA-style tracking on boards.
Each dot is one completed card.

fields.ticket_reminder: Sets a follow-up date for pending tickets. Tickets with a due reminder are sorted to the top of the list.
fields.ticket_close_date: When status is Pending close, the ticket is automatically closed on this date.
fields.ticket_macros: Runs a preset sequence of actions (change status, add reply, tags, etc.) defined by an administrator.
fields.ticket_checklist: Checklist items must all be completed before the ticket can be closed when a template is applied.
